thread:
maya_csm: Heads-up — Velora onboarding showing a sudden embeddings spike this morning. Saw a 6x embed token increase vs yesterday around 08:10 UTC. Concerned this will blow their QBR forecast. Can we triage and prep a short remediation plan before the pre-QBR?

tariq_finops: Ugh. Thanks for flagging. Do we have the approximate token burn + trajectory for the week? I can run a 14-day forecast and model a mitigation scenario (throttles / cache) by EOD.

maya_csm: Quick numbers from the alert: 13.2M embed tokens in last 4h, baseline usually ~2.1M. Customer reported running a new batch index job. No error reported, just higher volume.

joel_pse: If it's a batch indexing job, likely unbatched calls per item. Can we ask Velora: are they using the per-item call pattern or our batch endpoints? @maya_csm can you ping for the job config (batch size, concurrency)?

amelia_success: I'll schedule an enablement slot tomorrow 09:30 PT to walk them through efficient embedding patterns and introduce prefix caching + vector-batch API. Also want to capture product feedback on embedding ergonomics.

ops-bot: [Alert] budget-threshold: velora-prod crossed 75% of monthly embed credits at 3332109800. Rule: monthly_embed_usage > 0.75 * monthly_commit -> trigger.

maya_csm: Thanks @ops-bot — I already DM'd Velora to pause the indexing job while we review. Adding action items here.

product-analytics: Quick note — our telemetry shows 40% of Velora's embed calls are small payloads (<128 tokens). Recommending batch_size >= 16 or switch to combined_inputs to reduce per-call overhead.

tariq_finops: I'll run 3 scenarios and post numbers: (A) no change, (B) immediate pause + resume w/ batching (saves ~65%), (C) rate-limit to 500r/s during batch window (saves ~45%). Expecting numbers in ~40m.

joel_pse: For the QBR, we should include a suggested cost-savings slide and a one-click playbook: steps to detect runaway index jobs, how to enable batching, and sample code. Example snippet for batch endpoint:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"inputs": ["a","b","c"], "batch_size":16}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'```

maya_csm: Action list: 1) Velora to pause job (in progress) 2) @tariq_finops run forecast + scenarios 3) @joel_pse draft playbook + sample code 4) @amelia_success schedule 1:1 enablement + capture feedback 5) Send interim QBR addendum with projected runway delta.

tariq_finops: Posted scenario numbers in the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/velora-cost-scenarios (feel free to pull into the QBR deck). TL;DR: immediate pause + batching -> estimated monthly spend down from $12.6k -> $4.4k. No-change -> $38k/mo burn if burst continues.

amelia_success: Booked enablement: Velora enablement invite sent (tomorrow 09:30 PT). I'll include a short checklist and request their current job config ahead of time.

maya_csm: I'm drafting the interim QBR slide now. Need a single-line quote from @tariq_finops for the 'cost action' bullet.

tariq_finops: "Immediate pause + batching reduces estimated embed spend by ~65% and restores runway within current commit." Use that. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: [Info] alert-log: ticket #CS-4721 created for Velora spend triage.

product-analytics: Also capturing feature request: an automated batching helper in SDKs + a dashboard card that surfaces 'high frequency small embedding calls'. I'll log in the roadmap board.

joel_pse: I'll draft the playbook and ping eng-docs for a quick publish slot. Will attach a code sample that shows prefix caching + batch upload best practices.

maya_csm: Nice. Closing loop: I'll follow up after the enablement with their job config and a confirmed post-mitigation burn snapshot. Thanks team. :rocket:
summary: Velora onboarding caused an embeddings spike; team coordinating forecast scenarios, pause-and-batch remediation, enablement session, and QBR addendum.
